summary: JOINT Corp filed an 8-K disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell the assets of 45 company-owned or managed clinics in Southern California to Elite Chiro Group for $2.3 million. Terms include a $150,000 non-refundable down payment for exclusivity and escrow balance paid per clinic at closing, with 45 franchise agreements and non-exclusive development rights for 10 additional clinics. The board recommends the transaction. Closings are conditioned on lease assignments and customary conditions. What to watch: timing of individual clinic closings and lease assignment success; risk-arb angle limited by small size and asset-level execution.
